svg.title: TDR signatures of common discontinuities
svg.desc: Five simulated TDR traces with a 50 ps rise time on a 50 ohm FR-4 line, the discontinuity 10 cm away (1.23 ns round trip). Open: steps up to twice the incident level. Short: drops to zero. 1 pF shunt capacitance: a short dip. 2.5 nH series inductance: a short bump. A step to 75 ohms: steps up to 1.2 and stays.
svg.text: Reading a TDR trace: what each kind of discontinuity looks like
x axis: time after launch (ns); 1.23 ns = 10 cm
right axis (green): the same level as an impedance,
Simulated: ideal 50 ps-rise step, lossless line,
